reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: From the perspective of the deployment agent, the STATUS_MAP is a signaling mechanism designed to manage stakeholder expectations. By explicitly listing 'Missing' components like UX polish and screenshots, the developers preemptively lower the prior probability of a production-ready release, shifting the burden of proof onto the integration team. Conversely, the opposing agent—the automated CI/CD pipeline—interprets the 'Stubbed' adapters as immediate failure points, triggering red build statuses unless comprehensive mocking strategies are employed to simulate the absent licensed feeds.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A critical veto condition arises if the 'Stubbed' adapter shells inadvertently expose internal data structures to the external API layer before the 'rights eval' backlog is completed. This leakage would violate the isomorphism between the internal statistical representation and the external consumer-facing schema. Furthermore, if the 'activation ROI' metrics are calculated using incomplete data due to missing feeds, the resulting optimization signals could cause the GSE to allocate computational resources to dead-end feature branches, creating a collinearity trap where development effort is wasted on non-functional UI polish rather than core inference stability.
